question:
I've ran "dbt deps" on Windows in VSCode and it runs successfully. After I tried again with another package included, but it failed with the following; "[WinError 32] The process cannot access the file because it is being used by another process: 'dbt_packages\dbtvault-0.7.9'" I've checked and the folder has some contents marked as "Read-Only", every time I change the folder to be non-read-only it changes back.

Has anyone found a solution for this?

Thanks, Dan
title: dbt deps fails -> the file because it is being used by another process
answer:
Had similar issue with dbt deps when running in the VSCode terminal. I was able to bypass it by closing VSCode and running the command in the Anaconda Powershell.

Don't really know what it causes it. This only happens in my working machine, and I only have user rights. My colleagues that have admins rights don't seem to have the same problem.
